about_the_game:
introduction

Team Rush is a soccer competitive game where you morph into an adorable kitten, dashing across the verdant pitch to score goals! Whether you've ever played soccer or not, or even if you've never tried a soccer game before, here you can immerse yourself in the allure of football and fully experience the joy it brings!

Competition

The situation on the pitch changes in the blink of an eye; making the right move at the opportune moment is crucial to helping your team secure victory.

Cooperation

Teammates are partners you can always trust, working together with them to get out of trouble when the opponent is pressing.

Observation

In this first-person game, you must constantly monitor the movements of both your teammates and opponents, lest you lose possession of the ball and miss prime attacking opportunities.

Additional

Currently, we only have servers in the China, Eastern United States, Western United States, and Central Europe. As we are a small team of just two people, we deeply apologize to players from other regions. If you are located far from these areas, you may experience higher latency. In the future, we plan to gradually expand to more regions and hope for your understanding and patience.

short_description: 《Team Rush》 is a first-person online football competitive game where everyone can revel in the charm of soccer. Here, you will transform into a kitten, team up with your friends, and smash the ball into the back of the net!
